title: Briarthorn
wikitext:
'''Briarthorn''' is an [[herb]] that can be gathered by [[Herbalist]]s.

==Source==
Briarthorn can often be found at the base of trees. Rarely, [[Swiftthistle]] can be harvested along with Briarthorn by picking Briarthorn [[node]]s. It is also known to be dropping from various plant type monsters.
